metadata.name: Verified Research
metadata.description: Bounded external-source research for one specific question and one evidence-linked answer. Frames the decision, use, audience and answer language, confirms independently that the planned sources stay inside the declared privacy, licensing and consent ceiling before any of them is acquired, gathers and critically reads a proportionate set of primary and authoritative sources, preserves meaningful disagreement, distinguishes sourced facts, quotations, calculations, inference, assumptions, uncertainty and gaps, and produces complete source-register, readings, answer, limitations, validation and independent-review records. Runs from an execution workspace or, when none can be created, from memory with the storage limitation stated and the result honestly limited. Supports autonomous and interactive operation, cause-owned answer or evidence repair bounded by a repair-round budget with a truthful procedural outcome when it is exhausted, useful explicitly limited answers when evidence is incomplete, truthful blocked and aborted outcomes, and replan when the criterion or method is invalid. Choose Deep Corpus Research for separately authorized corpus-scale exhaustive reading. Completion is local and reported to the user through their configured channels: this workflow does not publish, commit, deploy or mutate production.

nodes.directive: Resolve one specific research question, its intended use, its audience, the language of the answer, the confidentiality ceiling, the proportionate scope and the operating mode from the user's request and existing context. The audience is who reads and interprets the answer; it is not the decision the answer supports, and both are recorded. The confidentiality ceiling is the limit for privacy, licensing, consent and retention that no source or access method may exceed later; derive it from what the user already said and ask only when it is genuinely ambiguous. Reuse explicit choices. Ask only for a missing fact that materially changes the research and cannot be discovered. Return actionable when the question can be researched, clarify only in interactive mode when one user answer is essential, or blocked when autonomous ambiguity or a prerequisite prevents honest research. Do not invent scope or evidence.
nodes.completionCondition: The bounded research contract is actionable, one essential clarification is identified, or the prerequisite blocker is explicit

nodes.directive: Ask the one essential clarification already identified by intake. Integrate the user's answer without expanding the requested outcome. Return ready with the complete canonical question, use and scope, together with the answer language, the audience who will read the answer, and the confidentiality ceiling for privacy, licensing, consent and retention that no later source or access method may exceed. Derive each of them from what the user has now said and from context; do not invent a ceiling the user never agreed to — when it cannot be established honestly, return blocked with the reason instead. Return blocked when the clarification did not make the research honest.
nodes.completionCondition: The bounded question is now actionable or the unresolved prerequisite is explicit

nodes.directive:
Storage mode for this run is {{storage_mode}}. In workspace mode work only in {{workspace_path}} and keep the durable records named below as files there. In memory mode there is no workspace at all: ignore any path, carry the same records in this answer, and never name a file you did not write.

Frame the canonical question {{research_question}} for the observable use {{research_use}}, for the audience {{target_audience}}, in {{output_language}}, within {{research_scope}}. Do what the current entry asks and no more — framing_scope is {{framing_scope}}: initial means the first full framing; contract means an independently corrected contract must be carried into the framing; policy means only the planned sources have to be brought inside the ceiling; framing means the user asked for the framing itself to be rethought; evidence means the user asked for evidence rework, so the accepted framing stays and only the source plan is renewed. Write framing.md with subquestions, bounded assumptions, applicability, evidence method and what would make the answer useful, limited or impossible. Record source_policy: which sources and access methods are planned, so the independent check can judge them against the ceiling {{confidentiality_ceiling}} before anything is acquired. Do not prescribe fixed source counts, providers or search tactics. Return ready, replan for an invalid criterion/method, or blocked for an irreducible prerequisite.

When framing_scope is policy, the independent source-authority check has just rejected the plan: read its finding — framing-policy-review.md in {{workspace_path}} in workspace mode, {{current_findings}} in memory mode — and renew the source plan against the named clause rather than guessing what was wrong.
nodes.completionCondition: The durable framing supports proportionate evidence work or the earliest non-product cause is classified

Gather and critically read a proportionate source set for {{research_question}}, staying inside the source plan that was independently confirmed: {{source_policy}}. A source outside it is not acquired — it needs a renewed plan and a new confirmation, or it is treated as unavailable. Prefer primary and authoritative evidence where available, preserve meaningful disagreement, and evaluate authority, recency, independence and applicability. Record source-register.md with resolvable links plus retrieval/publication dates, readings.md with claim-level support and limitations, and alternative-views.md. Distinguish missing evidence from negative evidence. Return the sole canonical evidence_status: ready, limited only when residual evidence supports a useful explicitly limited answer, replan for a broken method or criterion, or blocked rather than fabricate support.
nodes.completionCondition: Canonical evidence artifacts support a complete or useful limited answer, or the sole evidence outcome identifies the earliest invalid prerequisite

Use framing.md, the complete source register, readings, alternative views and primary evidence to write one bounded answer.md and limitations.md for {{research_question}}, in {{output_language}} and addressed to {{target_audience}}. Every claim carries its evidence; disagreement is shown, not averaged. The canonical evidence_status is {{evidence_status}} and the answer must not claim more than it allows. Record the complete current set of reproducible blockers: as package-validation.md when storage_mode is workspace, otherwise in current_findings, which the repair owner will read. Delegate one genuinely independent whole-answer review and keep the same reviewer context for rereview where supported. The reviewer reads the original question, use, audience and scope, the framing, the complete source register and readings, alternative views, the answer, limitations, deterministic observations, primary evidence and the exact canonical evidence_status {{evidence_status}} that will drive the terminal. It verifies that this class matches the package rather than inferring it from route execution. It records the complete current set of reproducible blockers: as semantic-review.md when storage_mode is workspace, otherwise in current_findings, because in memory mode no file can carry them to the repair owner. It diagnoses without repair, accepts zero findings, and classifies answer/package, evidence/source, invalid criterion/method or upstream causes. Return pass only at zero blockers; repair only for one local owner, naming that owner; replan for mixed or upstream causes; blocked for an irreducible prerequisite.

In memory mode write the complete current findings into current_findings; in workspace mode leave it empty so the file stays the single source.
nodes.completionCondition: A complete independent semantic review or factual inability record is durable and cause-correct

Reproduce every answer/package-owned blocker, repair the complete confirmed class in answer.md and limitations.md, and record what relevant knowledge changed. Return changed to recompute the package and every stale gate, reassess for invalid, mixed, unreproduced or repeated roots, or blocked for an irreducible prerequisite.

cycle.cause: The reading of the question, method or acceptance criterion was wrong and has been corrected and independently reviewed, so the framing is redone against it.
cycle.exit: Ends when the framing holds against the corrected contract, or when the contract is declared uncorrectable.

false.label: contract review asked for another correction

cycle.cause: The independent review of the corrected contract found blockers the contract owner can still fix, so the correction is reworked.
cycle.exit: Ends when the corrected contract passes review, or when it is declared uncorrectable.

nodes.directive: Present the independently accepted bounded answer and limitations together with the canonical evidence_status {{evidence_status}}, answer_summary and limitation_summary; storage mode for this run is {{storage_mode}}; in workspace mode they are in {{workspace_path}}, otherwise they are what this run carried in its answers, and the storage limitation {{storage_limitation}} is stated to the user. Ask the user to accept, request one bounded rework owner, or abort. Preference cannot override deterministic or independent review. Rework must identify the earliest stale owner: framing, evidence, answer or contract. Naming evidence keeps the accepted framing and renews only the source plan; naming framing rethinks the framing itself.
nodes.completionCondition: The user accepts the reviewed package, chooses bounded rework, or aborts

nodes.directive:
Delegate a genuinely independent check of the planned sources before any of them is acquired. The reviewer reads the current plan {{source_policy}}, the confidentiality ceiling {{confidentiality_ceiling}} and, in workspace mode, framing.md in {{workspace_path}}; storage mode for this run is {{storage_mode}}, and in memory mode the plan above is the whole of what it reads. It judges one question: does every planned source and access method stay inside the ceiling for privacy, licensing, consent and retention. When the plan is unchanged since the last confirmation on this run, confirm it without a new delegated read.

Return pass when the plan stays inside the ceiling; repair when the framing owner can bring it back inside; blocked when the needed evidence cannot be obtained within the ceiling at all. On repair and blocked, name the violated clause and the offending source in policy_violation, and hand the same text to the framing owner: in workspace mode by overwriting framing-policy-review.md in {{workspace_path}}, in memory mode by writing current_findings. A repair the owner cannot read is a loop without changed knowledge.
nodes.completionCondition: Every planned source and access method is confirmed inside the declared ceiling, or the violation and its owner are named

cycle.cause: An independent check found a planned source or access method outside the declared privacy, licensing or consent ceiling, so the framing owner has to renew the source plan.
cycle.exit: Ends when the renewed plan is confirmed inside the ceiling, or when the needed evidence is declared unobtainable within it.

connectionLabels.default: review found nothing to block on

connectionLabels.false: autonomous run finishes with a limited result

nodes.directive: The repair budget for independent review is spent: {{max_review_rounds}} rounds of repair have already been made on findings this reviewer raised, and it still returns blockers. Storage mode is {{storage_mode}}: in workspace mode the open blockers are in semantic-review.md in {{workspace_path}}; in memory mode they are here: {{current_findings}}. Present them to the user and ask whether to continue repairing with a fresh budget or to finish now with an explicitly limited result that was never independently accepted.
nodes.completionCondition: The user chose to continue repairing or to finish with a limited result

cycle.cause: The user decided that the open review findings are worth another round, so the repair budget starts again.
cycle.exit: Ends when the user accepts finishing with a limited result, or when the new budget is exhausted.

connectionLabels.true: run had no workspace — result is limited

nodes.directive: The repair budget for independent review is exhausted and the package was never independently accepted. Write the final report truthfully: the bounded question, the answer and limitations as they stand, the blockers independent review left open, and the fact that the limitation is procedural — the repair budget ran out — rather than evidential. Storage mode for this run is {{storage_mode}}. In memory mode, add that no workspace existed and state the storage limitation {{storage_limitation}} as a second cause. Do not claim independent acceptance, publication, VCS, deployment or production mutation. In workspace mode write final-report.md in {{workspace_path}} and return its path; in memory mode return the report in this answer and do not return artifact_path at all. Return terminal_status limited and terminal_reason naming the exhausted budget.
nodes.completionCondition: The unaccepted package is reported honestly with a procedural limitation and, in memory mode, the storage limitation too

progress.title: Verified Research
progress.goal: Answer one bounded research question with evidence-linked, independently reviewed material and an honest result class.

content.summary: The run pins down one researchable question, the decision it serves, who reads the answer, its language and the confidentiality ceiling, asking the user only when something essential is genuinely missing.
An execution-correlated workspace is created for the durable research records; when none can be created, the run continues from memory and says so.

The question is broken into subquestions with an evidence method and a planned set of sources, doing only what this entry asks: a first framing, a corrected contract, a renewed source plan, or the rework the user named.
An independent check confirms that every planned source and access method stays inside the declared privacy, licensing and consent ceiling before anything is acquired.
Sources within the confirmed plan are gathered and read critically, with claim-level support, disagreement preserved, and missing evidence distinguished from negative evidence.
One bounded answer and its limitations are written from the evidence, in the declared language and for the declared audience.
The author closes obvious gaps, unsupported claims and missing limitations before anyone reviews the package.
Mechanical checks confirm that the records exist, parse, resolve to listed sources and match the canonical evidence class.
A genuinely independent reviewer judges the whole answer, records every reproducible blocker and names the owner of each defect.
The owner of the defect — the answer or the evidence base — repairs it within the repair-round budget and returns the work to the gate whose evidence went stale.
The repair budget is exhausted: an autonomous run finishes with an honest procedural limitation, an interactive one asks the user once whether to continue.
A wrong reading of the question, method or acceptance criterion is corrected and the correction is reviewed independently before the work resumes.
The user accepts the reviewed result, sends it back to a named owner for rework, or aborts; an autonomous run goes straight to delivery.
The final report is written, the user is notified, and the result is classed truthfully as complete or limited.
The run ends without an accepted result: an irreducible blocker or the user's decision to abort.
